text_en: Of David, when he feigned madness before Abimelech, so that he drove him out, and he went away.
text_cn: 达味在阿彼默肋客前佯狂，被逐逃走时作。

text_en: I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
text_cn: 我必要时时赞美上主， 对他的赞颂常在我口；

text_en: My soul makes its boast in the Lord ; let the humble hear and be glad.
text_cn: 愿我的心灵因上主而自豪， 愿谦卑的人听到也都喜悦。

text_en: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.
text_cn: 请你们同我一起赞扬上主， 让我们齐声颂扬他的名字。

text_en: I sought the Lord , and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
text_cn: 我寻求了上主，他听了我的祈求： 由我受的一切惊惶中，将我救出。

text_en: Look to him, and be radiant; so your faces shall never be ashamed.
text_cn: 你们瞻仰他，要喜形于色， 你们的面容，绝不会羞愧。

text_en: This poor soul cried, and was heard by the Lord , and was saved from every trouble.
text_cn: 卑微人一呼号，上主立即俯允， 并且救拔他出离一切的苦辛。

text_en: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
text_cn: 在那敬畏上主的人四周， 有上主的天使扎营护守。

text_en: O taste and see that the Lord is good; happy are those who take refuge in him.
text_cn: 请你们体验，请你们观看： 上主是何等的和蔼慈善！ 投奔他的必获真福永欢。

text_en: O fear the Lord , you his holy ones, for those who fear him have no want.
text_cn: 上主的圣民，你们该敬畏上主， 因敬畏他的人，不会受到穷苦。

text_en: The young lions suffer want and hunger, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.
text_cn: 富贵的人竟成了赤贫，忍饥受饿， 寻求上主的人，却不缺任何福乐。

text_en: Come, O children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord .
text_cn: 孩子们，你们前来听我指教， 我要教你们敬畏上主之道。

text_en: Which of you desires life, and covets many days to enjoy good?
text_cn: 谁是爱好长久生活的人？ 谁是渴望长寿享福的人？

text_en: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking deceit.
text_cn: 就应谨守口舌，不说坏话， 克制嘴唇，不言欺诈；

text_en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
text_cn: 躲避罪恶，努力行善， 寻求和平，追随陪伴。

text_en: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry.
text_cn: 因为上主的双目垂顾正义的人， 上主的两耳听他们的哀声。

text_en: The face of the Lord is against evildoers, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
text_cn: 上主的威容敌视作恶的人民， 要把他们的纪念由世上灭尽。

text_en: When the righteous cry for help, the Lord hears, and rescues them from all their troubles.
text_cn: 义人一呼号，上主立即俯允， 拯救他们出离一切的苦辛。

text_en: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted, and saves the crushed in spirit.
text_cn: 上主亲近心灵破碎的人， 他必救助精神痛苦的人。

text_en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord rescues them from them all.
text_cn: 义人的灾难虽多， 上主却救他免祸；

text_en: He keeps all their bones; not one of them will be broken.
text_cn: 把他的一切骨骸保全， 连一根也不容许折断。

text_en: Evil brings death to the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
text_cn: 邪恶为恶人招来死亡， 憎恨义人者应该补偿。

text_en: The Lord redeems the life of his servants; none of those who take refuge in him will be condemned.
text_cn: 上主救助他仆人的生命， 凡投奔他的必不受处刑。
